title: Compose a timed exhibit reveal
scenario: V09 partition and cue authoring, I06 term inspection and I07 checkpoint replay
backend: AppKit content capture; Moxi floor projection and triangle picking; stylized perspective visitor-eye ray casting
fixture: Two parallel 7 m paths, one exhibit, one partition and one cue

slides.caption: Two walks to the exhibit
slides.expected: Both routes have cleared the partition. The selected visitor sees 75% light.

slides.caption: A spatial edit separates the routes
slides.expected: North loses sight at the cursor. South remains clear.

slides.caption: A brighter cue behind the wall
slides.action: Move the peak one second later.
slides.expected: North's eye view is occluded. South's exhibit marker brightens to 100% at the same 7 s cursor.

slides.caption: Compare from the other route
slides.expected: South becomes selected and stays clear; North stays occluded. Score and two history entries are shared.

slides.caption: First undo: timing
slides.action: Undo once while South is selected.
slides.expected: The cue returns to 75%, North stays occluded and one spatial edit remains.

slides.caption: Restore both representations
slides.action: Undo the cue, then the partition.
slides.expected: The peak returns to 6 s, the sightline clears and history is empty.

slides.caption: The partition reaches its travel limit
slides.action: Switch to South, scrub to 5 s, move −1 m and checkpoint. Advance the cue, move −1 m, then try once more.
slides.expected: The final move is rejected at −2 m. Three edits remain in history.

slides.caption: Return to the third action
slides.expected: South at 5 s, partition −1 m, peak 6 s and one history entry return.

slides.caption: Inspect the envelope width
slides.expected: The cue formula gives way to its asymmetric rise and fall durations.

slides.caption: Return to the selected term
slides.expected: The formula regains keyboard focus with width selected.

slides.caption: One cursor, different route durations
slides.action: Switch to North and scrub to 12 s.
slides.expected: North is at 12 s; South's eye stays at its 10 s endpoint. The shared cue is now 0%.

slides.caption: Record five actions
slides.action: Record route, time, partition, cue and time actions; finish.
slides.expected: The native transcript lists five accepted actions and both eye views follow the resulting session.

slides.caption: Explore after step three
slides.action: Play the sequence, explore at step three, then edit route, time and score.
slides.expected: The eye views follow the exploration while the authored transcript retains its third-step position.

slides.caption: Return to the recorded prefix
slides.expected: South at 4 s, partition −1 m, prior cue and complete history return at step three.

slides.caption: Resume the last two actions
slides.expected: The cue and cursor reach the recorded endpoint at South 5 s without changing the five-action sequence.

slides.caption: Undo the recorded cue
slides.expected: Cue timing returns to the prefix; South stays occluded and prior history is preserved.

slides.caption: Undo the recorded partition
slides.expected: The original partition returns and South's marker reappears, retaining pre-recording history.
